meta.title: So/such
meta.goal: Ya expresas resultado con so + adj/adv + that y such + (a) + sustantivo + that.

cards.title: So/such: qué expresa
cards.lede: Ya expresas resultado con so + adj/adv + that y such + (a) + sustantivo + that.

rows.value: The book was so good that I finished it in one day.
It was such a good book that I recommended it.

rows.key: so much / so many + sustantivo + that
rows.value: There were so many people that we couldn't enter.
The test was so hard I failed (that se puede omitir).

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Sujeto + verbo + so + adjetivo/adverbio + (that) + resultado · She ran so fast that she won.
Sujeto + verbo + such a/an + adj + sustantivo singular + (that) + resultado · It was such a loud noise that I jumped.
Sujeto + verbo + such + adj + sustantivo plural/incontable + (that) + resultado · They have such expensive cars that everyone looks.
The weather wasn't so cold that we needed coats. / It wasn't such a bad day.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: The mountain view was so breath-taking that we took dozens of photographs.
It was such a delicious meal that we decided to leave a generous tip for the waiter.
I had so much work to complete yesterday that I didn't sleep until 2 am.
There was such heavy traffic on the motorway that we missed our flight connection.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: SO (Modifica Adjetivos y Adverbios)
columns.rule: Se coloca directamente antes de un adjetivo o adverbio sin sustantivo posterior.
examples: The exam was so difficult that nobody passed.
He spoke so quietly that I couldn't hear.

columns.label: SUCH (Modifica Sustantivos / Grupos Nominales)
columns.rule: Exige ir seguido de un grupo nominal (adjetivo + sustantivo).
examples: It was such a difficult exam that nobody passed.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: It was so a beautiful day that we went to the beach.
It was such a beautiful day that we went to the beach. / The day was so beautiful that we went...
lines.note: no uses 'so' delante de 'a/an + adjetivo + sustantivo'; debes usar 'such a beautiful day'

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: so tired, so bright, so quickly.
such a mess, such a disaster, such nice people.
Usa 'so much' para incontables (so much noise) y 'so many' para plurales (so many cars).
En el habla cotidiana informal se suele prescindir de la palabra 'that'.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: The lecture was ___ boring that half of the audience fell asleep.
quiz.explain: Delante de un adjetivo aislado ('boring') sin sustantivo posterior se debe usar 'so'.

quiz.q: It was ___ unexpected news that nobody knew how to react initially.
quiz.explain: 'News' es un sustantivo incontable, por lo que exige 'such' sin artículo indefinido.

quiz.q: He made ___ many spelling mistakes in his essay that he lost ten marks.
quiz.explain: Con los cuantificadores 'many' o 'much' se combina siempre 'so' ('so many... that').
